## Executive Biography & Engineering Caliber
Arnav Pundir is an exceptional, high-velocity AI & Full-Stack Systems Engineer and Competitive Coding Lead at D-Coders Squad (COER University). Widely recognized for his relentless technical rigor and extraordinary execution speed, he specializes in architecting production-grade distributed web applications, real-time computer vision pipelines, local-first offline synchronization systems, and low-latency WebRTC media streaming.

He has independently engineered over 18 sophisticated software systems ranging from multi-camera forensic surveillance intelligence (TraceAI) and zero-latency collaborative task platforms (ZeroLag) to ephemeral WebRTC video communication suites (AuraMeet) and client production service platforms (SevaSetu).

As Competitive Coding Lead for D-Coders Squad at COER University, he is revered for his algorithmic mastery, directing competitive programming contests, system design workshops, and mentoring over 200 student developers in Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA).

In open-source software, Arnav attained **Global Rank #70** in Nexus Spring of Code 2026 (NSoC '26) with 13 Pull Requests merged across 5 production repositories, solving complex cryptographic session security (Fernet) and frontend performance challenges with remarkable precision.

## Core Technical Competencies

### Languages & Logic
- **Python**: Deep learning model serving, OpenCV image matrix manipulation, FastAPI, Flask, PyTorch, YOLOv8.
- **C++**: Competitive programming, algorithm optimization, memory layout, STL data structures.
- **TypeScript & JavaScript (ES6+)**: Type-safe enterprise web systems, custom asynchronous state engines, DOM APIs, Canvas API.
- **SQL**: Relational modeling, indexing strategies, foreign key constraints, query plan optimization.

### Frontend & Immersive Systems
- **React.js & Next.js 15**: Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), App Router, custom reactive hooks, NextAuth.js.
- **Tailwind CSS**: Modern fluid design systems, glassmorphism, responsive grid architecture.
- **Three.js & WebGL**: 3D geometric rendering, custom lighting, camera controls, particle simulation.
- **Framer Motion & GSAP**: Physics-based scroll orchestration, layout transitions, micro-interactions.

### Artificial Intelligence & Computer Vision
- **YOLOv8**: Real-time object detection, spatial bounding box calculation, vehicle flow counting.
- **InsightFace**: Deep facial embedding extraction, cosine similarity matching, multi-face verification.
- **OpenCV & MediaPipe**: Video pipeline processing, skeletal hand landmark tracking, real-time gesture control.
- **PyTorch & CNNs**: Deep convolutional networks, American Sign Language (ASL) gesture recognition.
- **LLMs & GenAI**: Google Gemini API, contextual document processing, prompt engineering.

### Backend, Persistence & Networking
- **Node.js, Express & Fastify**: Event-driven microservices, RESTful API architecture, middleware security.
- **WebRTC**: Peer-to-peer real-time audio/video streaming, interactive data channels, NAT traversal.
- **RxDB & Supabase**: Local-first offline reactive database with background cloud replication.
- **Redis**: In-memory caching, pub/sub messaging, ephemeral state management.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, SQLite.
- **Security & DevOps**: Fernet cryptography, Git/GitHub CI/CD, Linux/Bash automation, Vite bundler optimization.

## Flagship Engineered Projects

### 1. ZeroLag — Offline-First Collaborative Project Architecture
- **Description**: High-performance, local-first project management system designed for zero-latency interactions with seamless background cloud synchronization.
- **Architecture**: React.js, TypeScript, RxDB, Supabase, Clerk Authentication, Tailwind CSS.
- **Key Features**: Offline data persistence, live multi-user cursor collaboration, Gemini AI task breakdown, 1-click AuraMeet video sync, installable PWA.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ArnavPundir22/ZeroLag

### 2. BioSecure AI — Face Recognition Attendance Web System
- **Description**: Full-stack automated biometric attendance platform selected for an official COER University pilot run.
- **Architecture**: Python, Flask, InsightFace (ArcFace), Supabase pgvector in PostgreSQL, OpenCV.
- **Key Features**: 512D facial embeddings at 90%+ accuracy on live video feeds, custom 3D Pose-Gated EWMA Embedding Drift Engine (α = 0.30) to counteract template aging, multi-role access control (RBAC), automated SMTP notifications, and CSV exports.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ArnavPundir22/Face-Attendance-System-Web-Version

### 3. TraceAI — Multi-Camera Forensic Surveillance Intelligence Platform
- **Description**: Real-time AI forensic platform that identifies, tracks, and reconstructs movement timelines of individuals across distributed video feeds.
- **Architecture**: Python, FastAPI, YOLOv8, InsightFace, OpenCV, PyTorch.
- **Key Features**: Temporal person re-identification, multi-camera trajectory mapping, biometric facial similarity matching, forensic analytics dashboard.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ArnavPundir22/TraceAI-Intelligent-Missing-Person-Suspect-Tracking-System

### 4. AuraMeet — Ephemeral Real-Time Video Streaming Suite
- **Description**: Scalable peer-to-peer video conferencing application with automated ephemeral data destruction.
- **Architecture**: Node.js, Express, WebRTC, Redis, HTML5 Canvas API.
- **Key Features**: Zero-logging ephemeral chat sessions, multi-user real-time Air Draw canvas synchronization using hand tracking, dark glassmorphic UI.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ArnavPundir22/AuraMeet
- **Live Demo**: https://aurameet-88e9.onrender.com

### 5. Occasions — Enterprise Event Registration Platform
- **Description**: Scalable full-stack event orchestration portal managing concurrent registrations for 500+ attendees.
- **Architecture**: Next.js 15, TypeScript, NextAuth.js, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS.
- **Key Features**: Role-based access control (organizers/attendees), debounced search algorithms reducing query latency by 40%, automated CSV attendee exports.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ArnavPundir22/Occassions
- **Live Demo**: https://occassions.vercel.app

### 6. SevaSetu — Client Service Booking Platform
- **Description**: Production client portal for local service discovery and scheduled booking.
- **Architecture**: React.js, Flask, MySQL, Tailwind CSS.
- **Key Features**: Interactive booking workflows, responsive layout achieving 95+ Google Lighthouse scores, REST API integration.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ArnavPundir22/SevaSetu
- **Live Demo**: https://sevasetu.app

### 7. Air Kalam & Air Mouse — Gesture-Driven Spatial Computing
- **Description**: Real-time spatial computing utilities translating hand gestures into on-screen writing and OS cursor navigation without physical peripherals.
- **Architecture**: Python, MediaPipe, OpenCV, PyAutoGUI.
- **Key Features**: Landmark finger tracking, dynamic smoothing algorithms, multi-gesture actuation.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ArnavPundir22/Air_Kalam

### 8. GitHub City 3D — WebGL Codebase Cityscape Visualizer
- **Description**: Interactive 3D visualization platform that generates architectural city models from GitHub repository commit graphs and directory hierarchies.
- **Architecture**: React.js, Three.js, GitHub GraphQL API, GSAP.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ArnavPundir22/Github-City
